subject: Prelaunch triage: ops handoff, coverage, and docs

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ACME: Finalizing go-live window & evidence for SOC 2 scoping

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the run-through last week. We're lining up internal approvals and want to lock a go-live window and a list of evidence artifacts Redwood will need for our SOC 2 scoping. Attached is a simple spreadsheet of deadlines from our side (Acme_launch_req.xlsx). Key asks:

- Confirm a hard launch window (we are targeting the week of Jul 18)
- List of required prelaunch artifacts (logs, audit config, data retention docs)
- Point of contact for go-live ops (on-call / escalation)

Also looping in Acme Legal (cc'd) — they may send a handful of contract redlines and an evidence checklist. Do you have an internal readiness checklist you can share?

Thanks,
Amy Chen
Head of Platform Integrations
Acme Health

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME: Finalizing go-live window & evidence for SOC 2 scoping

Hi Amy — thanks for the spreadsheet, that's helpful. Quick responses and a proposed plan below.

1) Launch window: we can commit to a phased rollout starting Jul 20 with a narrow pilot (10% traffic) for 48 hours, followed by a full ramp Jul 23 if no high-severity regressions. If Acme needs the week of Jul 18 specifically, we can shift but need final sign-off by EOD Jul 8.

2) Prelaunch artifacts: attaching our Redwood_prelaunch_checklist.pdf which maps required artifacts to owners. Top priority from our side: audit-log export format, data-retention SLA, and KV-cache purge confirmation (for privacy boundary).

3) Ops point-of-contact: Marissa will own launch-day command; Laura will be primary engineering on-call for any infra rollbacks. Karthik & I will coordinate the biz/PM side.

Next steps (short):
- Marissa: share coverage matrix (who covers which hours) by Wed Jul 4
- Laura: confirm training slots for Acme ops (2x 60min) and provide a recording by Jul 10
- Amy/Acme Legal: send any redlines by Jul 8 so we can route to our commercial team

I'll also drop the prep doc here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcPrelaunchPlan

Thanks — attaching our checklist for your legal/ops to review.

Best,
Priyom Das
Director, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 3 Jul 2028 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME: Finalizing go-live window & evidence for SOC 2 scoping

Thanks — building the coverage plan now. A couple of operational clarifications:

- Coverage windows: proposed 24/7 handoff blocks for the first 72 hours (we'll need 3 people per block for M-F, 2 per block on weekend fallback).
- Handoff cadence: 30-minute rolling check-ins every 8 hours on launch days; one dedicated SRE in the channel at all times.
- Escalation: if an incident hits severity 1, we pull engineering triage, notify Acme POC and pause ramp for investigation.

I attached a first-pass coverage matrix (coverage_matrix_v1.csv). Please review and flag any missing people.

Also, we need a short runbook (1-pager) for Acme ops that covers common rollback steps — Laura, can your team author? If you want I can take the first draft and push it to the doc.

Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

I'll take the runbook and produce a 1-page rollback + verification checklist by Jul 7. Two gating items from infra that could block the Jul 20 pilot unless resolved:

1) Documentation gap: we still need an explicit description of how Acme will rotate their API keys for the pilot (affects cache invalidation). The doc should include the key rotation cadence and a sample request.
2) Training: our enablement team needs to confirm two 60-minute slots for a hands-on session with Acme's ops — I put two tentative ICS slots in enablement_training_slots.ics; please accept or propose alternatives.

I created a Jira SUP ticket SUP-3421 to track the key rotation doc and training acceptance. Linking it here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-3421

Amy / team — thanks everyone for quick turnarounds. Summary and decisions (final):

- Launch window: pilot begins Jul 20 10:00 PT (10% traffic) for 48 hours; full ramp Jul 23 08:00 PT pending no Sev1s. Acme to confirm acceptance of the phased ramp by Jul 8.
- Owners: Marissa = launch commander; Laura = engineering lead; Priyom & Karthik = commercial/PM; Vivek = compliance escalation yday. Vanessa = docs & enablement coordinator.
- Required artifacts: see attached checklist. Acme Legal to send any contract redlines by Jul 8; Redwood legal will respond within 48 hours of receipt.
- Ops: coverage_matrix_v1.csv accepted as baseline — Marissa to publish v2 (with names filled) by Jul 6.
- Training: two enablement sessions accepted; Acme to RSVP to the ICS invites by Jul 10.

Open items (owners):
- Key rotation doc (owner: Acme + Laura) — tracked in SUP-3421
- Audit-log sample format (owner: Acme) — due Jul 8
- Final sign-off (owner: Amy) — due Jul 8

Links: prep doc (https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcPrelaunchPlan), ticket SUP-3421 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-3421)

I'll move the checklist into the shared folder and loop in commercial if legal redlines arrive. If any of you see a blocking gap please call out; otherwise we'll proceed to lock resources for Jul 20.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Director, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference
